body.because: The swapped-remainder error (24 instead of 18) is structurally similar to the constant-difference trap (33 instead of 18): both arise from a heuristic that bypasses the full CRT computation.
body.holds_when: The moduli are coprime and the remainders are close in value.
body.relation_hint: NEW_001 (swapped-remainder trap) is a sibling error mode to SCR_001 (constant-difference trap)
body.weakens_when: The remainders are far apart and the error produces an obviously wrong value.
